FormModule.Comment:
module modified by Simon using JDAPI_LAF on Monday 08 September 2008 15:5:6****************************************************************************
*
* Title: OEIEXPT
* Author: Kerry Clark
* Date Written: 06-06-94
* Oracle Vers. Orig.: 7.0
* Forms Vers. Orig.: 3.0
*
* Revision History:
*
* Mod. By Date Vers Description of Changes
* -------------------------------------------------------------
* K. Clark 6-06-94 1.0 Initial Version
* M. Hoang 6-12-94 1.1 get latest from oeienter
* S.K. Clark 09 June 94 1.2 Added total products available, instock,
* order and allocated for available tiers
* block. Flipped order class and priority
* AR 59004 added '$' sign for dollar field
* added order charges block. Most changes
* from demo.
* M. Hoang 08-04-94 1.3 referenced avail_products, avail_tiers
* blocks from srvlib
* M. Hoang 08-10-94 1.4 fixed stranged message in ordered_by
* M. Hoang 08-11-94 1.5 get sub flag from vserv_contracts
* M. Hoang 08-16-94 1.6 fixed canceling order logic
* M. Hoang 08-18-94 1.7 referenced go_query from library
* M. Hoang 08-19-94 1.8 fixed long contact validation
* M. Hoang 08-20-94 1.9 fixed structure testing problems
* M. Hoang 08-23-94 1.10 referenced customer_id from library
* M. Hoang 08-23-94 1.11 referenced ordered_by from library
* check for no products in stock
* M. Hoang 08-24-94 1.12 referenced required_qty from library
* M. Hoang 08-25-94 1.14 referenced s_abo_rh from library
* M. Hoang 08-31-94 1.15 added change capability
* M. Hoang 09-06-94 1.16 referenced attrs block, print order slip
* M. Hoang 09-20-94 1.17 referenced ORDLIB
*
* Abstract:
* This form allows an operator to enter an order for blood products
* into the Serve*Care system from export customers. An export
* customer is defined as any customer out of this institution.
*
* Error Conditions:
* 0000 -- transaction committed
* 0600 -- unsuccessful commit
* 1712 -- no attributes defined
* 0500 -- date must be greater than or equal to eff date
* 0501 -- eff date cannot be less than current date
* 0327 -- Invalid input, must be a-z
* 5308 -- must be zero or greater
* 1704 -- order has not been completed
* 0201 -- all required fields must be entered
* 0200 -- invalid function key
* 1200 -- orderer name must be entered
* 0302 -- invalid customer
* 0303 -- invalid contact
* 0304 -- invalid contact
* 1300 -- invalid consignee ID
* 1706 -- invalid order class
* 1708 -- no standing orders set up
* 1705 -- invalid order type
* 0235 -- product type and blood type must be ent
* 1711 -- item has been canceled
* 0309 -- invalid product code
* 0300 -- invalid blood type
* 1707 -- invalid quantity
* 1100 -- going below minimum
* 1101 -- going below optimum
* 0400 -- invalid price
* 0301 -- invalid attribute group
* 0305 -- invalid attribute code
* 1303 -- duplicate attribute
* 0236 -- duplicate record
* 1313 -- invalid charge_code
* 1311 -- invalid credit indicator
* 1312 -- invalid charge amount
* 0323 -- invalid contact type
* 1302 -- Customer ID already exists --
* 7304 -- invalid state code
* 0318 -- a 'y' or 'n' must be entered --
* 0325 -- invalid chapter ID
*
* Inputs:
* Reference the following data base tables:
* Orders
* Order_items
* Order_item_attributes
* order_charges
* vserv_contacts
* consignee
* customers
* vserv_contracts
* vserv_products
* product_pricing_matrix
* serv_note_books
* active_products
*
* Outputs:
* Update the following data base tables:
* Orders
* Order_items
* Order_item_attributes
* order_charges
* vserv_contacts
* consignee
* customers
* vserv_contracts
* serv_note_books
*
* Assumptions and Limitations:
* None.
*
* Modules Referenced
* srvlib
*
* Functional Descriptions:
*
* This form allows order entry for user at a blook bank taking orders
* over the telephone. It is not intended for querying, updating or
* deleting orders. It contains 2 major blocks and 7 minor blocks. The 2
* major blocks are:
* - orders: this block contains all info related to an order, the
* associated database table is orders. Customer info and order summary
* are maintained in this block.
* - items: this block contains infos related to order line items, the
* associated table is order_items. Line item product type, blood type
* quatity, tier and unit price are in this block.
* The 7 minor blocks are
* -- Contacts: uses table
* vserv_contacts: This block allows the insert of a new contact person
* or updating and existing contact.
* -- Customers: uses table
* customer: This block allows the insert of a new customer
* or updating and existing customer.
* -- Contracts: uses table
* vserv_contracts: This block allows the insert of a new contract
* or updating and existing contract.
* -- Consignee: uses table
* consignee: This block allows the insert of a new consignee
* or updating and existing consignee.
* -- Attributes: uses table
* attributes: info for special order line items such as
* product_attributes.
* -- Avail_products: uses table
* vserv_products: This block is used to validate product types.
* This block also displays product type, blood type, optimal
* and minimal inventory levels. Inventory levels table is also
* used to query inventory levels for a product
* -- Avail_tiers: uses table
* product_pricing_matrix: active_products:
* This block queries units
* based on product type, blood type, tier (from day - to day).
* It displays the number of products ordered, allocated, and available.
* inventory_level that contains inventory levels for a product
* -- Answer: uses table
* answer confirm block for backing out of an order
* -- serv_note_books: uses table
* serv_note_books which allows user to leave notes for that order
*
*****************************************************************************

Item.Name: CONTRACT_ID
Item.Hint: Enter contract ID or use [LISTVAL]; [CREREC] to add customer.

Trigger.Name: KEY-CREREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 tmp_custm VARCHAR2(6);
begin
 go_block('contracts');
 if :orders.contract_id is not null
 then
 silent_query;
 if :contracts.contract_id is null
 -- invalid contract entered create a new one
 then
 begin
 tmp_custm := substr(:orders.customer_id,5,6);
 select nvl(max(to_number(substr(contract_id,8,3))),0)+1
 into :contracts.contract_id
 from vserv_contracts
 where customer_id = :orders.customer_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :contracts.contract_id := tmp_custm || '-' ||
 lpad(:contracts.contract_id,3,'0');
 exception
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 -- no contract entered, create a new one
 else
 begin
 tmp_custm := substr(:orders.customer_id,5,6);
 select nvl(max(to_number(substr(contract_id,8,3))),0)+1
 into :contracts.contract_id
 from vserv_contracts
 where customer_id = :orders.customer_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :contracts.contract_id := tmp_custm || '-' ||
 lpad(:contracts.contract_id,3,'0');
 exception
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 GO_ITEM('contracts.hospital_level');
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'CONTRACTS.CONTRACT_ID', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE );
end;

Item.Name: TIER
Item.Hint: Enter pricing tier or use [LISTVAL]; [NXTBLK] to enter attributes.

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_price_flag varchar2(1);
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select nvl(price_change_flag , 'Y')
 into temp_price_flag
 from customers 
 where customer_id = :orders.customer_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1);
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in selecting price change flag from Customers');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 recalc_price;
 :temp_unit_price := :items.unit_price;
 if temp_price_flag = 'Y' then
 set_item_property('items.unit_price', insert_allowed, property_true);
 set_item_property('items.unit_price', update_allowed, property_true);
 else
 set_item_property('items.unit_price', insert_allowed, property_false);
 set_item_property('items.unit_price', update_allowed, property_false);
 end if;
 next_item;
exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_MAX_PRICE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure get_max_price (price out number) is
 temp_price number := 0;
begin
 -- get tier pricing for this customer
 begin
 select nvl(unit_price,0) into price
 from product_pricing_matrix
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_0.chapter_id
 and product_type = :items.product_type
 and tier = :items.tier
 and customer_id = :orders.customer_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 price := 0;
 when OTHERS
 then
 tackle_error('Product_Pricing_Matrix, Customer');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- get standard tier pricing
 begin
 select nvl(unit_price,0) into temp_price
 from product_pricing_matrix
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_0.chapter_id
 and product_type = :items.product_type
 and tier = :items.tier
 and customer_id = :standard
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 temp_price := 0;
 when OTHERS
 then
 tackle_error('Product_Pricing_Matrix, Standard');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_price > price
 then
 price := temp_price;
 end if;
 --
 -- default to standard price for product type
 begin
 select nvl(std_price,0) into temp_price
 from vserv_product_types
 where product_type = :items.product_type
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 temp_price := 0;
 when OTHERS
 then
 tackle_error('Vserv_Product_Types');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 if temp_price > price
 then
 price := temp_price;
 end if;
end;

is

 null;

procedure validate_greater_zero(temp_num in number)
is

 end if;
 exception

 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;
